title: NASA’s Johnson Space Center Celebrates 65 Years
description: NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas, celebrates 65 years of exploration, innovation, and teamwork in 2026. From the earliest days in spaceflight, to continuous human presence aboard the International Space Station, to the Artemis Program, and future goals of a sustained human presence at Moon Base, Johnson Space Center continues to lead in human space exploration and inspire generations of explorers.
keywords: NASA Johnson Space Center, JSC, Apollo, Gemini, Space Shuttle, International Space Station, Artemis, Moon Base
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
